name: Blackdrop
author: Scott Angel
description: Bring classic Winamp visualization nostalgia to Omarchy with fullscreen, music-reactive motion. Switch among 12 presets with Left/Right, press Up to save one, or Down for Random per song. Blackdrop covers the bar and inhibits idle so the display and its audio stay alive; silence becomes OLED-friendly true black with a drifting neon Omarchy mark.
